items.title: What Does Meta (META) Have To Change After The $942 Million Teen Safety Ruling?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) has been ordered by a New Mexico state court to pay a US$942 million penalty tied to teen safety on its platforms. The ruling requires Meta to introduce stricter protections and usage limits for teenagers, directly affecting its core social media operations. The court compared Meta's impact on youth to public pollution, framing the decision as a major test case for online child safety rules.
